{{Quote|Pheromones are a key agent in communication among these species. Only by harnessing the proper pheromone mixtures can a close study of these creatures be conducted safely.|An excerpt from Volume 487|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
'''Behavioral Analysis of Marine Life''' was a multi-volume scientific work on the topic of marine life and their behavior. Volume 487 included a section on [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]], and the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Steel-Eye]] studied the work in an attempt to figure out a way to retrieve his crashed [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].
